args.body:
Dear Contoso Team,

We are writing to confirm the resolution of your case **C-8134** regarding the incorrect data residency region and the failed migration fee.

1. **Data Region Update:**
   The system has been updated to reflect your correct data residency region: **eu-west**. This change applies to all relevant databases tied to your account.

2. **Refund Processed:**
   A refund of **310** has been successfully issued to your designated account. The transaction has been logged under case ID **C-8134** for your records.

Please verify these details and reach out if you have any questions or require further assistance. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the migration issue.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
Case ID: **C-8134**
